description: 考研英语二作文中常见语法错误类型及纠正方案

errors.error_pattern: The number of + 复数名词 + are/were
errors.correct_pattern: The number of + 复数名词 + is/was
errors.example_wrong: The number of students who choose to study abroad are increasing.
errors.example_correct: The number of students who choose to study abroad is increasing.
errors.explanation: the number of 表示'……的数量'，是单数概念，谓语用单数

errors.error_pattern: A number of + 复数名词 + is/was
errors.correct_pattern: A number of + 复数名词 + are/were
errors.example_wrong: A number of factors is responsible for this trend.
errors.example_correct: A number of factors are responsible for this trend.
errors.explanation: a number of 表示'许多'，谓语用复数

errors.error_pattern: 主语后跟 with/together with/as well as 时谓语与后面的名词一致
errors.correct_pattern: 谓语应与主语一致，不受 with 等影响
errors.example_wrong: The teacher, together with his students, were present at the meeting.
errors.example_correct: The teacher, together with his students, was present at the meeting.
errors.explanation: with/together with/as well as 引导的部分不影响主语的单复数

errors.error_pattern: 不可数名词用复数谓语
errors.correct_pattern: 不可数名词用单数谓语
errors.explanation: information, advice, knowledge, equipment 等为不可数名词

errors.example_wrong: Each of the students have their own opinions.
errors.example_correct: Each of the students has his or her own opinion.

errors.error_pattern: 描述图表趋势时时态不一致
errors.correct_pattern: 图表描述通常用一般过去时（已发生的数据）或一般现在时（普遍趋势）
errors.example_wrong: The chart shows that the number increased in 2015, and it is still growing in 2020.
errors.example_correct: The chart shows that the number increased from 2015 to 2020 and has continued to grow.
errors.explanation: 同一段落内时态应保持一致，或根据时间线合理切换

errors.correct_pattern: since + 过去时间点，主句用现在完成时
errors.example_correct: Since 2010, the number has increased dramatically.
errors.explanation: since 引导的时间从句暗示'从过去到现在'，主句应用现在完成时

errors.error_pattern: in recent years + 一般过去时
errors.correct_pattern: in recent years + 现在完成时
errors.example_wrong: In recent years, more and more people chose to exercise regularly.
errors.example_correct: In recent years, more and more people have chosen to exercise regularly.
errors.explanation: in recent years 暗示'到目前为止的近几年'，用现在完成时

errors.error_pattern: 可数名词单数前缺冠词
errors.correct_pattern: 可数名词单数前需加 a/an/the
errors.example_wrong: Chart shows that number of visitors increased.
errors.example_correct: The chart shows that the number of visitors increased.
errors.explanation: 特指的名词用 the，泛指的可数名词单数用 a/an

errors.error_pattern: 不可数名词/抽象名词前误加 a/an
errors.correct_pattern: 不可数名词前不加 a/an
errors.example_correct: This is good advice. / This is a piece of good advice.
errors.explanation: advice, information, equipment, furniture 等不可数名词不能直接加 a/an

errors.correct_pattern: 某些固定搭配必须带冠词
errors.explanation: on the other hand, in the long run, at the same time 等为固定搭配

examples.correct: result in ... (导致) / result from ... (由...导致)
consist of (由...组成) / consist in (在于)

common_uncountable_nouns.note: 通常不可数（作为学术论文时可数）

errors.example_wrong: The number increased dramatically, this trend is expected to continue.
errors.example_correct: The number increased dramatically, and this trend is expected to continue. / The number increased dramatically. This trend is expected to continue.
errors.explanation: 两个独立句子不能仅用逗号连接，需要连词、分号或分成两句

errors.example_wrong: Because the economy is developing rapidly.
errors.example_correct: Because the economy is developing rapidly, people's living standards have improved.
errors.explanation: because 引导的从句不能独立成句，需要主句

errors.example_wrong: Walking in the park, the flowers were beautiful.
errors.example_correct: Walking in the park, I found the flowers beautiful.
errors.explanation: 分词短语的逻辑主语必须与句子主语一致

errors.example_wrong: Students spend too much time on their phones. It is a serious problem.
errors.example_correct: Students spend too much time on their phones. This phenomenon / This excessive use is a serious problem.
errors.explanation: it/this/that 的指代对象应明确，避免歧义

errors.example_correct: Everyone should express his or her opinion. / All people should express their opinions.
errors.explanation: everyone/someone 等不定代词传统上搭配单数代词（现代英语中 their 也逐渐被接受）
